publicFunctions.parse_expiry(text) -> int: CB02. type(text) is str and fullmatch ASCII (?:0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19}) and int(text) <= 2**64-1; else ValueError 'C2B-ARGV: ...'. Pure.
publicFunctions.read_public_file(path, cap) -> bytes: CB04. type(path) is str, non-empty, no NUL; type(cap) is int >= 0. os.open(path, O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK|O_CLOEXEC); fstat S_ISREG; os.read loop of at most cap+1 bytes; more than cap bytes is refused; fd closed on every path. Policy violations and OSError from open/fstat/read/close become ValueError 'C2B-READ: ...' (class name and errno only). MemoryError and KeyboardInterrupt propagate.
publicFunctions.parse_public_json(raw, cap) -> dict: CB05. In order: type(raw) is bytes; type(cap) is int >= 0; len(raw) <= cap; no EF BB BF prefix; strict utf-8 decode; lexical depth pre-scan <= 16; json.loads(str) with hooks refusing duplicate keys (object_pairs_hook), fraction or exponent (parse_float), NaN/Infinity/-Infinity (parse_constant), integer literals over 20 characters (sign included) or not ASCII -?(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*) (parse_int); top-level dict; post-walk depth <= 16 and every key and string utf-8 encodable (no lone surrogate). RecursionError and all decode or hook ValueErrors become ValueError 'C2B-JSON: ...'. Pure.
publicFunctions.check_setup_link(export, setup_raw) -> s: CB06. type(export) is dict; type(setup_raw) is bytes; export.get('setupRecordSha256') is a str fullmatching [0-9a-f]{64} and equal to hashlib.sha256(setup_raw).hexdigest(); returns that hex; else ValueError 'C2B-LINK: ...'. Pure.

privateHelpers._close_after_failure(fd): os.close ignoring OSError, only while another exception is in flight
privateHelpers._read_regular_fd(fd, cap) -> bytes: fstat S_ISREG check plus bounded read loop
privateHelpers._json_check_tree(value, depth): authoritative depth and string walk; top-level object is depth 1, at most 16 nested containers

refusalMessages: ValueError starting 'C2B-<STAGE>: '; always one line; no path or other caller-supplied text echoed
